context: A mom and son prepare for summer
purpose: Teach: 太陽光/リモコン/ヘア/サマー/水着/コーラス/熱中/ナチュラル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、屋根の太陽光パネル、業者が今日来るよ。
lines.en: Sho, the solar panels on the roof — the installer is coming today.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but gentle. Light, informational tone. Brief pause before the dash. Eyes on him, checking if he needs anything else.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん。エアコンのリモコン、どこ?
lines.style: Answering automatically while already thinking ahead. Quick, not distracted-sounding, just efficient. The tone of a six-year-old on his own agenda.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: リビングのテーブルね。ヘアカット、来週行く?
lines.en: It's on the living room table. Are you going for a haircut next week?
lines.style: First half crisp and helpful. Second half softens — pivoting to check on him. Warm but not hovering. The question lands gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: サマースクールも、申し込んでくれた?
lines.en: Did you already sign me up for summer school?
lines.style: Quiet curiosity, no anxiety underneath. Just confirming. Small voice, the way a child asks when he trusts the answer will be yes.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。水着、サイズ確認しよう。
lines.en: Yes. Let's double-check what size swimsuit you need.
lines.style: Steady, moving through the list. No hesitation. The rhythm of a parent who has already thought three steps ahead. Practical affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 学校のコーラス発表、お父さんも来てくれる?
lines.en: Is Dad coming to my school chorus performance too?
lines.style: Hopeful opening. The question matters to him — he wants confirmation. Small lift at the end, waiting for the yes. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。熱中症対策、お茶持って行こう。
lines.en: Yes. We'll bring tea so you don't get overheated.
lines.style: Reassuring. The yes comes first and clear. Then practical — not worried-sounding, just thinking ahead for him. Steady and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達のママ、ナチュラル系ファッションで素敵だよね。
lines.en: Your friend's mom has such a nice natural style, doesn't she?
lines.style: Observant, almost thinking out loud. Genuine admiration in the tone. A small, unguarded moment — noticing something nice. Warm, not performative.
